title: Finiteness of Nonscattering Wavenumbers for Herglotz Incident Waves
summary: This paper continues the study initiated in \cite{VogXia25} on nonscattering phenomena for inhomogeneous media. We investigate star-shaped domains in $\mathbb{R}^2$ and establish finiteness results for nonscattering wavenumbers associated with Herglotz incident waves of fixed density. First, for ellipses we establish finiteness for all constant contrasts $q\neq 1$, removing the geometric restrictions required in previous work.
